properties.longDescription: This magnificent colonial-style property has been lovingly restored to offer modern living while retaining period charm. The ground floor features a spacious reception hall, elegant living room with antique details and original teak flooring, a separate dining room perfect for entertaining, and a contemporary open-plan kitchen with modern appliances. The first floor offers four generous double bedrooms, including a master with en-suite, and a family bathroom. Additional features include a landscaped garden with tropical plants, off-street parking, and a separate servant quarters.

properties.description: Modern apartment with stunning ocean views
properties.longDescription: A beautifully presented two-bedroom apartment located on the 12th floor of this prestigious development in Colombo's prime waterfront area. The property boasts an open-plan living/dining area with floor-to-ceiling windows offering panoramic views across the Indian Ocean. The sleek kitchen is fitted with integrated appliances and granite worktops. The master bedroom features built-in wardrobes and an en-suite shower room, while the second bedroom is served by a contemporary family bathroom. Residents benefit from 24-hour security, swimming pool, gymnasium, and secure underground parking.

A delightful three-bedroom semi-detached house situated in a quiet residential neighborhood in Nugegoda. The property offers versatile accommodation comprising an entrance hall, through lounge/diner, and a fitted kitchen with access to the rear garden. Upstairs there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom. The property benefits from ceiling fans, inverter air conditioning, a private driveway providing off-street parking, and a well-maintained rear garden with fruit trees. Conveniently located close to schools, supermarkets, and public transport.

properties.description: Stylish studio apartment in city center
properties.longDescription: An attractive one-bedroom apartment located on the fifth floor of this modern apartment complex. The property features a bright and airy living room with large windows, a separate modern kitchen, a good-sized double bedroom with built-in wardrobes, and a contemporary bathroom. The apartment benefits from air conditioning, 24-hour security, and is offered with one parking slot. Ideally positioned for access to local amenities, restaurants, and excellent transport connections. Walking distance to Liberty Plaza and major shopping areas.

An exceptional five-bedroom detached family home set within landscaped grounds of approximately 40 perches. This impressive property offers generous accommodation including a grand entrance hall, formal drawing room, separate dining room, study, and a stunning open-plan kitchen/family room with island and premium imported appliances. The first floor provides five bedrooms, three with en-suites, plus a family bathroom. Outside, the property features a private swimming pool, landscaped tropical garden, triple garage, and automated security gate. A truly remarkable home in the prestigious Battaramulla area.

A stunning three-bedroom penthouse apartment occupying the entire top floor of this modern development in the heart of Rajagiriya. The property features a magnificent open-plan living space with high ceilings and large windows flooding the room with natural light. The bespoke kitchen is fitted with high-end appliances and breakfast bar. Three double bedrooms include a master suite with dressing area and luxury en-suite. The highlight is a private rooftop terrace offering spectacular views across Colombo city and distant hills. Additional benefits include lift access, 24-hour security, and two allocated parking spaces.

A charming two-bedroom cottage brimming with character located just minutes from Negombo beach. The property comprises an inviting living room with tropical wooden features, a separate dining area, and a recently updated kitchen with access to the courtyard garden. Upstairs offers two double bedrooms with built-in storage and a modern bathroom. This delightful home benefits from ceiling fans, solar hot water system, and is ideally located within walking distance of the beach, restaurants, and local markets. Perfect as a holiday home or permanent residence.
